blocks.text: GPT-5.6 Sol is a proprietary language model from OpenAI, released on Jul 9, 2026.
At $4 input and $20 output per million tokens, it ranks #32 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 1.1M tokens ranks #8 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets coding, agents, reasoning workloads.

Flagship of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna tiers), announced as a limited preview Jun 26 2026 with general availability Jul 9 2026. Strong on long-horizon, command-line, and multi-step coding tasks. On the independent ARC-AGI-3 public set, OpenAI reported the official-harness score understates it: enabling retained reasoning and compaction lifted the result from 13.3% to 38.3%, beating Claude Opus 5's 30.2% on the same set — a real, reproducible optimization rather than a benchmark discrepancy, but flagged here since the two settings are not on by default. API identifier gpt-5.6-sol, knowledge cutoff Feb 16 2026. Superseded as OpenAI's flagship by GPT-6 Astra (Sep 3 2026).
